a.lede: Agentic AI led to a sixfold year-on-year influx of new code at GitHub, leading the company to add 4 million CPU cores and 160PB of storage to its datacenters
a.title: GitHub says massive influx of AI-generated code required extra 4 million CPU cores and 160 petabytes of storage to manage

b.lede: Someone listed a massive 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7M. Packed with 9,600 A100 GPUs and 4,200 EPYC CPUs, it even ships for free.
b.title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
